card.decodeStrataHelp: Live sliding-window decode rate. When that window is unavailable, the active-slot mean sums each active slot’s generated tokens divided by its elapsed time since first token; it excludes prefill time.
card.perStreamDecodeHelp: Average decode throughput of one running stream (1 / mean seconds per output token). Only engines that publish a per-token latency histogram report it.
card.prefillStrataHelp: Engine-reported mean for computed/new prompt tokens. It may be from an earlier prefill and is not an aggregate across slots.
card.prefillProcessingStrata: A prompt is being processed; no current prefill rate is available.
card.prefillProcessing: A prompt is being processed. The engine reports its speed only when the request finishes.
card.perRequestPrefillHelp: Effective prefill rate of one request (prompt tokens ÷ prefill seconds over finished requests). The prompt counter includes prefix-cache tokens, so this is an effective speed, not raw GPU speed; it is held between completions.
card.tokPerSecondPerRequestEffective: {{value}} tok/s per request — effective (incl. cached tokens)
card.loadedModelTitle: {{name}} · loaded model; throughput shown for the monitored endpoint above
